playbackRate.description: Default playback rate when this sample is played. Default: 1
playbackRate.markdownDescription: Default playback rate when this sample is played. Default: 1

additionalProperties.description:
A named sample definition: an entry the runtime registers with the SFX
manager so subsequent scene-def references can play it by name.  Mirrors the
`SfxDef` type used by the runtime sound engine.
additionalProperties.markdownDescription:
A named sample definition: an entry the runtime registers with the SFX
manager so subsequent scene-def references can play it by name.  Mirrors the
`SfxDef` type used by the runtime sound engine.

sfx.description: Name of the sfx sample to loop (key into `sfxDefs` or a builtin).
sfx.markdownDescription: Name of the sfx sample to loop (key into `sfxDefs` or a builtin).

xfade.description: 0..1 fraction of the sample for crossfade ramp on each end. Default: 0.1
xfade.markdownDescription: 0..1 fraction of the sample for crossfade ramp on each end. Default: 0.1

filter.description: Optional biquad filter applied to this voice.
filter.markdownDescription: Optional biquad filter applied to this voice.

refDistance.description: Distance at which attenuation begins. Default: 1
refDistance.markdownDescription: Distance at which attenuation begins. Default: 1

rolloff.description: Attenuation curve exponent: gain = 1 / max(1, dist/ref)^rolloff. Default: 1
rolloff.markdownDescription: Attenuation curve exponent: gain = 1 / max(1, dist/ref)^rolloff. Default: 1

cullThreshold.description: Linear gain threshold below which mixing is skipped. Default: 0.001
cullThreshold.markdownDescription: Linear gain threshold below which mixing is skipped. Default: 0.001

items.description:
A spatial looped sound source placed in the world.  Plays automatically when
the level loads.  The `sfx` field references either a builtin sfx name or
one of the keys in the level def's `audio.sfxDefs` map.
